livingCosts.notes: The University of Osaka publishes only a total (its prospective-student FAQ says about ¥100,000 a month for daily necessities, and about ¥100,000-120,000 including rent), not a breakdown. Figures are JASSO 2023 Lifestyle Survey of Privately-Financed International Students (令和5年度私費外国人留学生生活実態調査, table 7-4), Kinki region average monthly spending in ¥1,000s: housing 40 + utilities 7, food 32, commuting 4, personal = hobbies/leisure 7 + other daily costs 8. Excludes study/research costs (54, includes tuition) and insurance/medical (3).

programmes.name: School of Engineering
programmes.notes: Standard national-university (MEXT) rate: tuition ¥535,800/yr (¥267,900 per half year), matriculation (admission) fee ¥282,000, same for undergraduate and graduate students. Entrance examination fee (¥17,000 undergraduate / ¥30,000 graduate) excluded. Admission guides say the amounts are provisional and a revised rate applies if fees are changed during enrolment, so not cohort-locked. Japanese-taught. 2024 and 2025 figures from the university-wide undergraduate admission guides for April 2024 (令和6年度 総合型・学校推薦型選抜) and April 2025 (令和7年度 一般選抜) entry.
